serialization.normalization: NFC; CRLF/CR to LF; strip outer whitespace only
serialization.comparison_match: normalized whole field; Unicode word boundaries (?<!\w) and (?!\w)
serialization.body_policy: preserve all normalized body text; never delete internal repeated text
serialization.guide_context_policy: audit_only; no metadata injection; retain operational guide already in text
serialization.query_policy: NFC; CRLF/CR to LF; strip outer whitespace; no field prefixes, expansion or retrieval instruction

audit.fingerprint_payload: SHA256 UTF8 compact sorted-key JSON array, chunk_id ascending; objects: chunk_id, text_sha256, tokens

ranking.short_list_policy: return fewer results; missing metric positions contribute zero

lexical.normalization: serialization normalization, then casefold and U+2019 apostrophe to ASCII apostrophe

R1.name: TF-IDF + cosine
R1.tokenizer: lexical.token_pattern with re.findall; custom tokenizer; token_pattern=None in TfidfVectorizer
R1.fit_scope: 371 serialized corpus chunks only; never fit queries
R1.score: exact cosine; dot of L2-normalized sparse query/corpus vectors

R2.name: BM25Okapi
R2.idf: ln((N-df+0.5)/(df+0.5)); negative IDF replaced with epsilon*mean_raw_IDF
R2.query_tf: sum once per token occurrence, per rank_bm25 get_scores
R2.tokenizer: same lexical unigram tokens as R1
R2.construction: pretokenized lists; tokenizer=None to avoid multiprocessing
R2.score: get_scores; explicit ranking.sort; do not use get_top_n default sorting
R2.eligible_scores: strictly greater than zero; discard zero and negative scores before rank assignment
R2.idf_safety: log mean_raw_IDF; fail pre-evaluation review if <=0; do not silently change variant

R3.name: BGE-M3 Dense + exact cosine
R3.max_length_scope: both corpus and query, including special tokens
R3.truncation: forbidden; fail on overlength before inference
R3.normalization: official L2; convert output to float32 and L2-normalize again before score/storage
R3.score: CPU float32 normalized inner product over all 371 vectors
R3.eligible_scores: all finite scores, including zero/negative cosine
R3.inference_path: official inference forward in eval + inference_mode; avoid wrapper automatic OOM retry

cache.format: float32 NPY matrix plus JSON row manifest, chunk_id ascending
cache.partial_cache_policy: mark incomplete; never evaluate; preserve verified rows for explicitly approved resume

R4.name: BM25 + BGE-M3 Dense + RRF
R4.component_configs: exactly shared R2/R3 results; no retuning
R4.candidate_policy: full dense ranking plus every strictly positive BM25 candidate
R4.bm25_candidate_limit: all strictly positive scores; at most371
R4.formula: sum over present components of weight/(60+one_based_rank)
R4.latency_policy: time both component pipelines once plus fusion; do not report fusion-only as end-to-end

R5.name: BGE-M3 Sparse
R5.definition: official token-ID lexical weights; matched-token dot product, same serialized text and query
R5.activation_gate: separate resource test, exact scoring and tokenizer aggregation policy approval

R6.name: BGE-M3 Multi-vector / Late Interaction
R6.definition: official normalized ColBERT token vectors; per-query-token max passage-token dot, then mean per official colbert_score
R6.activation_gate: separate resource/storage test; special-token masking and scoring policy approval

queries.overlap_policy: no shared intent/paraphrase family across pilot/main; exact/normalized and expert semantic review
queries.validation_status_policy: draft and draft_pending_expert_review are not validated or frozen; expert_reviewed requires documented human sign-off; frozen requires a separate freeze decision
queries.main_category_allocation: five categories x8 and five x7; assignment fixed before query drafting; style cross-tab reviewed
queries.answerability: expert-confirmed against frozen corpus; zero-relevant query blocks qrels freeze
queries.main_visibility: sealed after drafting/validation; no parameter selection from main results

qrels.format: TREC UTF-8 TSV: query_id, iteration=0, chunk_id, grade; no header
qrels.primary_assessor: WO domain expert judges every selected pair; no AI labels
qrels.secondary_assessor: independent second qualified reviewer; qualifications and WO experience recorded
qrels.independent_subset_policy: all exhaustive-audit pairs plus20percent per pooled query, selected before labels and blinded
qrels.adjudication: resolve every double-judged disagreement and ambiguous pair with WO expert; third expert if unresolved; retain original labels
qrels.unjudged: absent means unknown; explicit0 means human-judged nonrelevant
qrels.overlap_chunks: judge each chunk independently; preserve relevant overlap; no document collapse
qrels.freeze_policy: selected pairs adjudicated as required, all R1-R4 top10 judged, exhaustive audit complete; supervisor-approved limited scope
qrels.corpus_change_policy: new snapshot and query/qrels versions; recheck all answerability and evidence; never silently carry labels by chunk_id

pool.outside_pool_strata: one per available operational category; redistribute exhausted strata deterministically; no duplicates
pool.sampling: seed42; sorted IDs then deterministic per-query/category shuffle; record actual sampling probabilities
pool.outside_scope: exclude rank pool; sample before labels; do not infer unknown labels
pool.expert_additions: all further evidence found by WO expert; record source and additional workload
coverage_audits: pool overlap and contribution by method
comparison pooled-vs-full qrels on exhaustive subset
pool.new_method_policy: expand pool and qrels version; re-evaluate every compared method; do not score new method on selectively incomplete top10

exhaustive_audit.category_allocation: one query per each of10 categories; resolve feasibility before ranking
exhaustive_audit.selection: predeclare and hash IDs before retrieval results; stratified seed42; independent of performance
exhaustive_audit.generalization: audit subset only; no claim of exhaustive Recall across75 or statistical power from10 queries

workload.timing_status: planning assumption; not measured; calibrate on development
workload.exclusions: calibration, expert additions, adjudication, breaks and revisions; actual pool overlap may reduce counts

evaluation.complete_qrels_scope: 10 predeclared exhaustive main queries; all75 only if exhaustive option approved/completed
evaluation.known_recall_denominator: count judged grade>=1 only; not corpus Recall estimate
evaluation.ndcg_pooled_ideal_scope: known human-graded relevant chunks only; unresolved relevance outside pool remains unknown
evaluation.unjudged_top10_policy: block compared run-set evaluation until every returned top10 position is human-judged; never drop or impute
evaluation.unjudged_outside_top10_policy: remain unknown; do not assign grade0; use explicit pooled metric labels
evaluation.pooled_bias_note: with top10 fully judged, known Recall and pooled nDCG can be optimistic relative to complete qrels; no completeness assumption
evaluation.aggregation: macro mean within published common query-ID scope for all methods; pilot,pooled-main,exhaustive-subset separate
evaluation.zero_result: score0 for Recall/MRR/nDCG when query has known relevant chunks; no dummy qrel
evaluation.no_known_relevant_pooled: needs expert search; block query until known relevance or exhaustive confirmed no-answer; never infer no-answer from an empty pool
evaluation.confirmed_no_relevant_before_freeze: revise/replace through versioned expert review before results; answerable benchmark intended
evaluation.confirmed_no_relevant_after_freeze: retain query; Recall/nDCG NA,RR10=0; report IDs/count and common denominator; no result-driven deletion/replacement
evaluation.missing_returned_positions: zero gain/no hit, not unknown returned chunk and not a fabricated qrel

paired_analysis.unit: paired query; use same frozen query IDs and qrels scope
paired_analysis.effect: per-query metric differences, mean/median delta, wins/ties/losses
paired_analysis.family_dependence: one main query per information_need_family; otherwise cluster-resample whole families
paired_analysis.optional_test: two-sided paired label-swap randomization test; exchangeability assumption stated; Holm correction for two contrasts
paired_analysis.incomplete_judgment_uncertainty: query bootstrap does not capture missing-label or assessor uncertainty; report separately
paired_analysis.exhaustive_subset_analysis: descriptive sensitivity only; small n10 and no full75 extrapolation

measurements.warmup_inputs: fixed development queries only; same policy for all methods
measurements.query_order: seed42 shuffle of sealed query IDs; identical order for methods, recorded
measurements.query_cache: disabled for timed tests; corpus cache resident
measurements.indexing_time: cold index construction including corpus serialization/tokenization/embedding/storage; model loading reported separately
memory: process RSS and Windows peak working set
minimum available RAM and commit headroom
measurements.storage: index/cache logical bytes and allocated disk bytes separately; exclude shared checkpoint but report it separately
measurements.comparison_label: system pipeline on declared hardware; CPU/GPU latency is not intrinsic algorithm superiority

hardware.ram_gate: dynamic preflight required; lower-margin run needs recorded explicit approval, not automatic override
hardware.oom_policy: stop own test/run; log full error and affected ID; release GPU; mark partial cache incomplete; no automatic retry
hardware.cpu_fallback: separate RAM reassessment/approval and FP32 validation; never silently mix device/precision within one run
hardware.cloud_policy: separate declared environment/run; same protocol/snapshot hashes; no mixing local/cloud latency
